messages:
Tara: Heads up — my flight's delayed, looks like I won't be online reliably for the 23:00-07:00 UTC window. Can @Maria swap primary with me for that block? There's already a P2 pager earlier in ap-southeast, so want to make sure coverage continuous.
Incident Bot: [ALERT] 2850012200 — Pager: ap-southeast pods restarting (service: inference-gateway). P2. Pager sent to @oncall-primary. Link: https://incident.redwood/2850012200
Maria: I can take primary for 23:00-07:00 UTC. Confirming I have console and KMS access. Will need canary keys for the dedicated cluster — Tara can you hand off any hot keys?
Tara: Thanks — handing over canary/key list now: https://redwood-infra/runbooks/canary-keys
Tara: Runbook summary: follow steps under 'ap-southeast pod restarts' — key items:
```
1) scale deployment inference-gateway to 3
2) check logs: kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference-gateway --tail=200
3) if crashloop, set image to previous tag: kubectl set image deploy/inference-gateway inference-gateway=registry/redwood/inference-gw:v2026-03-01
4) escalate to oncall-sre if >10 restarts in 10m
```
Maria: Got it. I'll start the swap in rotation calendar and set myself primary in PagerDuty. @Noah can you be secondary for that window?
Noah: Yup, I can be secondary 23:00-07:00 UTC. I'll watch latency dashboards and alerts.
Pranay: Quick check — are we deconflicting with the DB migration scheduled at 02:00 UTC? If yes, Maria you should be aware of extra noise.
Maria: I saw the migration note earlier — it was postponed to 04:30 UTC. Good to know. I'll plan to be near laptop then.
Liam: One small ask — update the handoff message in the calendar with the runbook link and add the temporary contact: oncall-sre@redwood.com. Also confirm you both have AWS console role 'oncall-webops'.
Maria: Confirmed AWS role present. I'll update the calendar now and set status in Slack.
Tara: Thanks all. I'm assigning shadow to @Noah until handoff completes. Final signoff?
Noah: Signoff from me.
Maria: Signed — I'm primary from 23:00 UTC to 07:00 UTC. If anything escalates ping me on DMs and page on PD.
Incident Bot: [NOTE] Swap recorded: 2850012345 — Primary changed to Maria for 2026-03-16 23:00:00 -> 2026-03-17 07:00:00 UTC. PagerDuty and calendar entries updated.
Tara: Appreciate it. I'll be reachable for escalation on flight (limited mobile). :airplane:
Maria: Thanks — got it. I'll post a brief recap at 00:30 UTC after warmup.
